extracted.name: Chinese stir fry - Snow Peas with dried shrimps and garlic
extracted.description: A simple and humble snow peas recipe prepared & cooked using Chinese stir fry technique. #CA2025 #CookpadApron2025 #June2026 #snowpeas #lunch #dinner #stirfry #appetizer #garlic #Asian #texas #HEB #snowpea #peas #shrimps #beans #chinese
ingredient_lines: 2 bird eye chillies or any red chili
1. Adjust chillies to your heat tolerance
2. Chicken bouillon or chicken seasoning powder can be substituted with other type of bouillon
3. Try adding ginger - thinly slice young ginger & then JULIENNE these slices into FINE STRIPS. Add to the pan together with crushed or pounded ingredients
1. Snow peas are to be thinly sliced and this is a must for this recipe
2. Another thing to remember is, ingredients like chillies, garlic and shrimps are to be FINELY crushed or pounded in mortar and pestle to release their flavor and aroma
3. Chinese stir fry technique involves cooking ingredients quickly over high heat with continuous stirring & tossing
4. All ingredients are cut into small, uniform pieces so they cook evenly
instruction_lines: Remove both end of the snow peas. See pic below. Fill a bowl with water and wash snow peas. Repeat washing if necessary. Drain and discard water.
Slice snow peas into thin slices. You can grab a few, stack them and slice them at once. It doesn't have to be perfect. See pic below.
Gather dried shrimps, garlic and chillies. Using mortar and pestle, pound them well. Prepare the seasonings and turmeric.

Over medium heat, add 4 tbsp of oil (or as needed) in a pan or wok. Before the oil gets too hot, add finely crushed shrimps, garlic and chillies (see pictures). Add turmeric powder. Stir and continue to sauté these ingredients until aromatic. Add snow peas.

Continue to stir for a minute. Add seasonings - a TSP of chicken bouillon (or to taste) and 1/2 TSP of sugar. Over medium to high heat, continue to stir and cook until snow peas turn bright green and it takes less than 5 minutes depending on how strong is your heat. Taste and adjust seasonings if necessary. Remove from the heat and serve hot over plain warm rice.
